list.alertRule: Report anything listed at or under its max (an under). Blank means watching, with no cap. Maxes are all-in: price plus shipping.

art.heading: ART
art.scope: Unique works only — no prints, editions, posters, or merch.
art.drawings: Drawings: works on paper — marker, ink, pencil, pastel, crayon, gouache.

sports.heading: SPORTS — game-used
sports.scope: True game-used only. Never game-issued, never replicas.
sports.signedRule: Signed game-used is fine — only signed replicas are out.
sports.photoRule: Photo is excluded except photo matched; photomatching is authenticity proof.

grails.heading: GRAILS — Bell System Technical Journal
grails.scope: Original printings only — single issues or bound annual volumes. No reprints, facsimiles, photocopies, PDFs, or print-on-demand.
grails.volumeRule: A volume number maps 1:1 to its year (vol 1 = 1922). No caps — every grail is watched, so every listing is reported.

notes.art: Unique works only — no prints, editions, posters, or merch. Standard exclusions on every art entry are print, poster, lithograph, serigraph, screenprint, giclee, edition, t-shirt, merch, book, magazine, and sticker.
notes.drawings: Works on paper; marker, ink, pencil, pastel, crayon, or gouache.
notes.sports: True game-used only. Never game-issued and never replicas. Standard exclusions are issued, replica, game style, facsimile, reprint, youth, toddler, mini, plaque, 8x10, coin, trading card, and Funko. Photo is excluded except photo matched; photomatching is authenticity proof. Signed game-used is fine; signed replicas are out.
notes.furniture: Grouped as Lighting and Seating. Storage / Tables is an intentionally empty subsection — empty on purpose, not lost configuration.
notes.grails: Bell System Technical Journal landmark issues (Nyquist, Hartley, Bode, Shannon, Shockley, Hamming, Telstar, ESS, CCD, UNIX, AMPS). Original printings only — single issues or bound volumes; reprints, facsimiles, photocopies, PDFs and print-on-demand are out. Watched with no cap.
notes.researchShape: Research results record title, year, medium, dimensions, venue, sale date, estimate versus hammer/sold price, and link. Flag provenance, COA, signature, and unique versus print/multiple.
notes.priceMax: Report anything listed at or under its max. A blank cap means watching with no cap. Every max is all-in: price plus shipping. Tax is excluded.

tactics: Vague-seller-wording tactics cannot be automated queries; run these manually.
